pr_title: log-backup: added more robust error handling for log backup advancer
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: hillium <yujuncen@pingcap.com>

<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #41082 

Problem Summary:
When etcd client closes the channel, the current implementation would trivially exit without retry.

### What is changed and how it works?
This PR make the etcd adapter send an error response when the channel is about to be closed.
It also added some logs so we can meet the real error of closing.

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [x] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [ ] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
- [ ] No code

### Release note

<!-- compatibility change, improvement, bugfix, and new feature need a release note -->

Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note.

```release-note
Fixed a bug that may cause PITR stop advancing the progress when connection to PD is changed.
```

issue_context.title: log-backup: cannot observe new tasks when there are some errors in the etcd
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
During log backup enabled, make the etcd client meet some watch errors.

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
Log backup runs as expected.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
The log backup advancer exits, and cannot get the add task events.
According to the goroutine dump, we found the etcd wather goroutines are exited.

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
v6.5.0

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
comments:
We did have a retry when meeting error, the problem here is we haven't check the error in the response and send it to the advancer, but directly closed the channel.

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/706c3fa3c526cdba5b3e9f066b1a568fb96c56e3/br/pkg/streamhelper/advancer_cliext.go#L110-L119

Also when the channel get closed unexpectedly, we also need to add some guards to it, say returning a `io.EOF` for hinting the upstream channel has been closed.
Then, the channel (in some way) would provide the information why it is closed in any condition it closed.

review_comments: please also add a log here
